**Finding: MINCOMMIT — Compliant (preferred position).**

The Agreement imposes no minimum purchase, take-or-pay, volume floor or shortfall penalty on our side:

- **Section 2.1(b)/(d) (p0034–p0037):** transfers of Additional Receivables happen only on an Acquisition Date and only if the Transfer Notice, Credit Enhancement Test, Pool Composition Tests and Depositor certifications are satisfied — there is no obligation on the Issuer to acquire any minimum amount of Receivables.
- **Consideration is per-acquisition:** the Issuer pays only the Additional Receivables Cash Transfer Amount (plus a Class B Certificate balance increase) for the Receivables actually transferred, which is the equivalent of paying only for what is ordered.
- **Section 2.1(c) (p0036):** the Issuer expressly assumes no other obligations in connection with the transfers.
- **Required Acquisition Deposit Amount / Required Negative Carry Amount (p0225, p0398, p0564, p0927):** Revolving Period waterfall and credit-enhancement mechanics funded from the Issuer's own collections — not commitments to buy volume.
- **Section 4.3(h) (p0211):** the only "shortfall" deposit duty runs against the Marketing Agent (counterparty), so it benefits us and is not flagged.

No redline proposed.
